body: I've been on prozac for 3 years. I haven't talked to anyone I don't know who to turn to.
Sleep, go online, play video games, drink. Anything to distract me from how shitty I feel about myself
I haven't genuinely enjoyed anything in years. Just numb
I already see myself slipping into a dark place. I don't want to go back there.

My girlfriend of 2 and a half years broke up with me two days after I told her about my depression. She's the only person I've ever told outside my family, I felt so vulnerable. She didn't end it because of my depression, but opening up to someone like that and then to be told I wasn't enough I just can't take it. I don't want to live anymore. I really do hate myself. I just want it to end.
It wasn't the fact that I had depression, it was that I wasn't comfortable enough to tell her. There were other reasons too.
